transport: HTTP/1.1 over two separate Unix sockets; no public listener

identity.capability: per-attempt random >=192-bit secret, memory only, revoked when run ends; never model-visible or logged

run.messages: initial user messages {role:user,content:string}; system_prompt is separate
run.tools: OpenAI function definitions supplied by Go; only these business tools may be registered
run.result: Exact Go-accepted JSON value, copied as an opaque fully validated raw value token in Python. Preserve numeric lexemes including exponent, negative zero and precision; do not decode/re-encode through binary64. Go retains strict canonical equality.

failure.counts: integers within this phase budget; no null/extra fields
failure.privacy: private control-only fixed metadata; no exception message/class, request/response, argument, token, credential or profile; not model-visible

callback.field_presence: type/round/call_id required; name+arguments only for tool; content only for finish; usage optional only for model_end

rejection_response.format_only: optional true for last diagnosis format repair

callback.idempotency: serialize per session; identical call_id and canonical request replay returns cached response without re-execution; changed content for same call_id is fatal
callback.model_start: reserve next strictly consecutive round before every actual provider call; no implicit provider retries
callback.model_end: optional actual provider usage; once per reserved round, never provider body or hidden thought
callback.tool: round must be current, <=2 per round; names/schema/budget/domain fences independently enforced by Go
callback.finish: Go validates required tools, evidence and report; accepted result is stored server-side; no further tools/model calls after acceptance
callback.planning_terminal: a valid propose_collection tool may return terminal=true+result. Runner stops its Agent without another model call; only Go-confirmed plan is returned

diagnosis.knowledge: 可选知识先验由Go绑定，自动E2与模型工具合计最多8条trace；Skill必需工具和当前测量引用由Go验收，撤销及来源变化在终态事务再次校验。
diagnosis.format_retry: fifth call only after invalid fourth-round finish, no tools; Go independently enforces

cancellation: Go polls domain fences <=500ms, cancels upstream HTTP context and revokes capability. Runner detects disconnect/deadline, cancels framework/model/callback tasks. In-flight domain writes remain lease/attempt fenced. Restart reruns bounded persisted phase, not exact token-level continuation.
security: Runner has no database, object-store, Docker, collector or root code-executor credential/socket.
Model credentials come from runner server-side secret configuration, never request/model/tool parameters.
Runner rejects model mismatch and tools outside phase allowlist. No builtin shell/file/network/MCP tools or autonomous context-compression tool is enabled.
Disable SDK request/tool/content printing and hidden-thought persistence; only bounded safe runtime counters may be persisted.
Go remains authoritative for authorization, user consent, target identity, transactions, lease/attempt, tool outcomes and final acceptance. No automatic fallback to legacy on AgentScope failure.
Socket directories have separate owners, group 10003, setgid and no consumer write permission; mount consumer socket volume read-only.
Health endpoint GET /health returns framework/version/readiness metadata only and performs no model call.
